key_idea: The best group for v is everyone who follows v and is not followed back, so CC(v) is the number of in-edges u->v without the reverse edge v->u.
sketch: Encode each edge as u*(n+1)+v, sort, and for each edge binary-search its reverse; count the unreciprocated in-edges per vertex and take the smallest vertex with the maximum. O(M log M) with M up to 1e6, needs fast input and 64-bit keys.
